effects: The signature lets anyone submit the vote through castVoteBySig. The contract then records a vote by the signer on proposal `proposalId`, For if `support` is true and Against if it is false.
The vote weight is the signer's POOL voting power at the proposal's start block (pool.getPriorVotes). It is read from storage and added to forVotes or againstVotes.
The vote is final. receipt.hasVoted becomes true, so the signer cannot vote again or change the vote on this proposal.
No tokens, ETH or allowances move.
formats.shown: The intent is "Cast vote on PoolTogether proposal". The fields show the proposal id as a raw number and the vote as For or Against.

findings.title: Ballot does not show the vote weight or that the vote is final, because the contract sets both from storage.
findings.evidence: GovernorAlpha.sol _castVote: `uint96 votes = pool.getPriorVotes(voter, proposal.startBlock);` and `require(receipt.hasVoted == false, ...)` / `receipt.hasVoted = true;`. The message has only proposalId and support. Descriptor fields: 'Proposal id' (raw), 'Vote' (enum).
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the weight. You can change the intent to "Cast final vote on PoolTogether proposal" if you want the signer to see that the vote cannot be changed.
